fields.distanceInMeters: Along the great circle, on the sphere; 0 or more
fields.bearingInDegrees: 0 to 360, clockwise from north. inverse leaves it out where it's undefined: the same point, antipodes, a pole, or due north, where 0 and 360 are both right.
fields.backAzimuthInDegrees: The bearing plus 180°, in 0 to 360, so the back azimuth of 180° is 0°
fields.direction: right, left, or none for no turn. A turn of exactly 180° is right.
fields.magneticDeclinationInDegrees: True to magnetic, east positive, from the magnetic model: true = magnetic + declination
fields.convergenceInDegrees: True to grid, east positive, from UTM: true = grid + convergence. The G-M angle is declination minus convergence.
fields.angleUnit: degrees, or mils at 6400 to the circle
fields.bearingText: Degrees rounded half up to a whole degree, three digits and °, 000° to 359°; or mils rounded half up, four digits, 0000 to 6399. Round first, then wrap: 359.6° is 000°.
fields.compassPointText: Bowditch's abbreviation for the nearest point, like N, NNE or NE by N. Half-way between two points goes clockwise.
